themes.title: Fuel Policy Rollbacks & Price Backlash
themes.blurb: Right-wing figures in both Norway and the US are heavily focusing on energy and fuel costs as a key political issue. In Norway, the Progress Party (FrP) is mounting intense public pressure against record fuel prices while demanding tax relief, while in the US, the Trump administration is dismantling federal vehicle fuel efficiency standards.

themes.title: Law and Order Rhetoric Amid Public Safety Concerns
themes.blurb: Right-wing coverage across Norway and the US highlights a parallel emphasis on public safety, state enforcement powers, and law enforcement gaps. Norway's Progress Party criticizes government inaction on youth crime and police resource shortages, while US reporting focuses on federal election integrity probes and strict deportation enforcement.
